'''Gark''', also known as '''Gark the Indomitable''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] and leader of Gamorrean warriors that joined [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="Battle" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gark the Indomitable appears as the first boss in "The Battle of Ilum," one of the original endgame Flashpoints for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Battle" />
